comparison.derivation: (VIN - VOUT) / IOUT at the datasheet RON test condition, against the 25 C typical (less half its last printed digit) to maximum interval.

source_fact.detail: RON On-resistance VIN = 12 V, IOUT = -200 mA, 25 C: typ 79, max 86 mohm (105 at -40..85 C, 115 at -40..105 C)

limits: Operating-point RON of TI's model at the datasheet's VIN 12 V / IOUT 200 mA / 25 C row. Does not check CT rise time, QOD discharge, UVLO or thermal behavior.
